name: EPIC 212512857
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 7.5 solar radii and 0.87 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212512857 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.503314 (16th-84th percentiles 7.282095-7.773327), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,017 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.87 solar masses and 7.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,833 K at its surface.
